trust.projectCode: Only run projects you trust. Commands may execute project and lifecycle code with your user permissions. npm 12 may skip dependency scripts even when the command succeeds, unless the root allowScripts permits them; root and explicitly run scripts still execute, and root preinstall runs before dependencies are installed. Inspect allowScripts yourself; the app does not approve scripts, rebuild packages or recover missing build artifacts.
trust.config: Configuration in .npmrc, pnpmfile and plugins may execute code or affect tool behavior. Strict npm configuration may make the command fail; the app adds no ignore-scripts, allow-scripts or strict-npmrc overrides and does not retry automatically.
trust.network: Commands may use the network, shared stores and access or change files outside the project.
trust.logs: Logs may reveal secrets; filtering cannot guarantee removal of every secret.
trust.noRollback: There is no rollback. Stopping or failure may still leave partial changes.
trust.stop: Stopping may miss processes that escape the tracked process tree.
trust.path: Replacing the target path during startup is not fully prevented.

designSystem.title: Design system
designSystem.description: Shared tokens and components for the interface. Every sample reads straight from the active theme: switch Light/Dark or the language in the top bar to see it change.

brand.title: Brand
brand.description: The PkgSteward logo is a letter P whose bowl is a package box. The background uses primary and the strokes use primary-foreground, so the logo follows the preset.

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: Same shape as the app icon in the browser tab. The navigation bar uses the 32px size.

lockup.title: Logo with name
lockup.description: The logo sits before the app name, 8px apart. The name is large, bold red text: smaller red text does not have enough contrast in dark mode.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: Background/foreground pairs of the active preset, shown side by side in both modes. Components use token names only, never color codes.

typography.title: Typography
typography.description: Hierarchy comes from size and weight, not color. The main typeface is Inter.
typography.sample: Scan and clean up the Node.js projects on this machine
typography.monoNote: Only for command logs, paths and version numbers

shape.title: Shape and spacing
shape.description: Corner radius, shadow, spacing and content width shared by every screen.

radius.title: Corner radius
radius.description: The whole scale derives from --radius (16px): change that one variable and every corner follows.

shadow.title: Shadow
shadow.description: Cards sit flat. Only modals and floating layers (menus, selects) cast a shadow.

spacing.title: Spacing
spacing.description: 8px base step; 4px and 6px are for tight gaps inside chips. Sections are 32px apart on mobile, 48px on tablet and 64px on desktop.

container.title: Content width
container.description: Content is at most 1280px wide, with 16px side gutters on mobile and 24px from 640px up.

actions.title: Buttons and badges
actions.description: Buttons are 40px tall with 16px corners. Badges are pill-shaped with 12px bold text.

buttons.title: Button
buttons.description: Each screen has at most one default (red) button for its main action; everything else uses secondary. Each row shows sizes sm, default, lg, icon-sm, icon, icon-lg and the disabled state.

badges.title: Badge
badges.description: For short statuses: versions, dependency types, vulnerabilities.

forms.title: Forms
forms.description: Inputs are 44px tall; on focus they get a 2px inner border and a 4px blue outer ring. Press Tab to see it.

input.title: Input and Label
input.invalidMessage: Invalid version. Use 1.2.3 or a range like ^1.2.0.

checkbox.title: Checkbox
checkbox.description: Checked boxes use the text color, not red.

select.title: Select
select.description: Sizes default and sm, with groups, a locked item and the disabled state.

toggleGroup.title: ToggleGroup (filter chip)
toggleGroup.description: Pill-shaped chips that invert when selected. Used to filter lists.

data.title: Data display
data.description: Cards, tables, tabs, and loading and empty states.

card.title: Card
card.description: Card background (cream in light mode), no border, no shadow. Sizes default and sm.
card.summary: {count, plural, one {# direct dependency} other {# direct dependencies}}
card.activeVersion: Version in use on this machine

table.title: Table
table.description: Bold column headers and a hairline under each row. Wide tables scroll horizontally inside their frame.
table.caption: demo-app dependencies (sample data)

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.description: The line variant (the default) underlines the active tab in red; the default variant uses a pill background.
tabs.label: Package manager
tabs.content: Packages installed globally with {manager} will show up here.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Progress bars use the text color, not red.

skeleton.title: Skeleton
skeleton.description: Placeholder for loading content, shaped like the real content.

empty.title: Empty
empty.description: Empty states say what this is, why it's empty and what to do next.
empty.emptyDescription: Install a package with npm, pnpm or yarn using the -g flag, then rescan to see it here.

overlays.title: Floating layers
overlays.description: Tooltips and menus float above the page with 8–16px corners; only floating layers cast a shadow.

tooltip.title: Tooltip
tooltip.description: Hover or focus a button to see it. Icon-only buttons always need a tooltip.
tooltip.rescanHint: Discard previous results and rescan the whole folder

dropdown.title: DropdownMenu
dropdown.description: Every item type: plain, with shortcut, checkbox, radio, submenu, disabled and destructive.

dangerous.title: Dangerous actions: Preview → Confirm
dangerous.description: Deleting files or changing global versions always takes two steps. The UI never calls execute before the user has seen the preview.

steps.preview: Call the preview API to get the exact list of affected items.
steps.dialog: Show a confirmation dialog listing every item. Cancel uses secondary; the confirm button uses destructive.
steps.execute: Only after the user confirms, call execute with confirm: true.

npmVersion.noOptions: No npm 11 or 12 version is available to choose.
npmVersion.listHint: Change or remove it in the npm version card above.

risk.MACHINE_WIDE: This operation affects the whole machine, not a single project.

job.title: Activity and logs
job.continues: Activity continues when the tab is hidden or you leave this page. Use Stop to request termination.
job.startUnknown: It is unclear whether the request was accepted. Refresh status manually; the operation is not resent automatically.
job.cancelUnknown: The stop result is unconfirmed. Refresh status before requesting further cleanup.
job.lost: The backend no longer tracks this activity. This does not prove that processes stopped or global packages are unchanged. Check Task Manager and refresh status manually.
job.pollPaused: Reading status or logs paused after an error. Refresh or retry reading manually.
job.mayHaveChanged: Global packages may have changed even if the operation failed or stopped. The inventory may be stale.
job.gateHeld: The operation still holds the machine-wide lock. Other operations are blocked. Once stopping finishes, retry process cleanup if offered; it never reruns the package command.
job.refreshRequired: The final inventory could not be verified. Refresh inventory after process cleanup; success is unconfirmed.

errors.UNKNOWN: An unknown error occurred. Check status and logs before another action.
errors.PROJECT_NOT_SCANNED: A required scanned project is unavailable.
errors.INPUT_CHANGED: Inputs changed. Refresh inventory and request a new preview.
errors.WORKSPACE_LEAF: This operation is not supported for a workspace leaf.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_MANAGER: This package manager is unsupported. Only supported npm and pnpm installations can be used.

errors.TOOL_LAYOUT_UNSUPPORTED: This tool installation layout is unsupported. The app will not download or replace the tool.
errors.TOOL_VERSION_MISMATCH: The tool version is unsupported or no longer matches the verified version, or the backend Node.js does not meet the tool requirement. Refresh and preview again.
errors.CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED: The configuration cannot be verified safely.
errors.INVALID_PACKAGE_SPEC: Enter a valid package name and an exact version or registry tag.
errors.SCRIPT_NOT_FOUND: The requested script was not found.
errors.READERS_RUNNING: A scan, analysis, size measurement or preview is active. Wait, then refresh status.
errors.RUNNING: Another operation is active or process cleanup is unfinished. Refresh status and wait or request a stop.
errors.COMMAND_FAILED: The command failed. Check logs and the actual exit code.
errors.CANCELLED: The operation was stopped on request.
errors.TIMED_OUT: The operation exceeded its time limit.
errors.SHUTDOWN: The backend is shutting down and requested a stop.
errors.TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED: Some processes may still be running. The machine-wide lock remains held. Retry cleanup when available.
errors.AUDIT_WRITE_FAILED: The audit record could not be written. Success is unconfirmed.
errors.CACHE_INVALIDATION_FAILED: Saved data could not be refreshed. Success is unconfirmed.
errors.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR: The backend encountered an internal error.
errors.LOCATION_AMBIGUOUS: The global package or command location cannot be verified unambiguously.
errors.REGISTRY_CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED: The registry configuration is unsupported for this operation.
errors.LINKED_PACKAGE: This package is linked or outside a verified layout. It is read-only.
errors.PROTECTED_PACKAGE: This package or its commands belong to protected tooling. Global package actions are disabled.
errors.BIN_CONFLICT: A command conflicts with protected tooling, another package or an unknown owner.
errors.NO_VERSION_CHANGE: The target resolves to the currently installed version.
errors.PREVIEW_CHANGED: The verified facts changed. Review a new preview before confirming.
errors.PREVIEW_EXPIRED: This preview expired. Request and review a new preview.
errors.PREVIEW_CONSUMED: This preview was already used. Check status before requesting a new preview.
errors.REQUEST_MISMATCH: The request does not match the saved operation.
errors.LIMIT_EXCEEDED: A safety limit was exceeded. The result is incomplete and changes are disabled.
errors.REGISTRY_UNAVAILABLE: The registry is unavailable. Try loading versions again later.
errors.REGISTRY_INVALID_RESPONSE: The registry returned invalid or incomplete package data.
errors.REGISTRY_NOT_FOUND: The package, version or tag was not found in the registry.
errors.REGISTRY_RATE_LIMITED: The registry limited requests. Wait before trying again.
errors.REGISTRY_AUTH_REQUIRED: The registry requires credentials. This registry operation is unsupported.
errors.INVENTORY_FAILED: Inventory could not be read completely. Changes remain disabled until it can be verified.
errors.POSTCONDITION_FAILED: The resulting package state could not be verified. A partial change is possible.
errors.MANAGER_DISABLED: This version cannot manage global packages of this package manager yet. Manage them in a terminal for now.
errors.PNPM_GLOBAL_NOT_CONFIGURED: pnpm global packages are not set up. Run pnpm setup in a terminal, open a new terminal, then restart PkgSteward.
errors.GLOBAL_GROUP_UNSUPPORTED: This package was installed with others in one pnpm add -g command. PkgSteward only displays it; manage it in a terminal.
errors.NPM_PREFIX_IS_NODE_DIR: The npm global folder is inside the Node installation folder (for example, with nvm). PkgSteward does not replace Node's own npm.
errors.NPM_OVERLAY_ABSENT: No npm is installed in the global folder; terminals already use the Node-bundled npm.
errors.NPM_OVERLAY_NOT_BROKEN: The npm in the global folder is not broken, so no repair is needed. Refresh the inventory to see the current state.
errors.NPM_DELEGATION_UNVERIFIED: PkgSteward cannot prove terminals would run the new npm: Node's npm launchers have an unknown form. You can still return to or repair npm.
errors.TARGET_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED: Only stable npm 11 or 12 versions that are not deprecated are supported.
errors.ENGINE_UNSUPPORTED: This npm version does not support the running Node version. Choose another version.
errors.FILE_IN_USE: A file is in use by another program, for example a terminal running npm. Close that program and try again.
errors.ACCESS_DENIED: Permission to delete an item was denied. Check the folder permissions or antivirus software, then try again.
errors.DELETE_FAILED: An item could not be deleted. Refresh the inventory and preview again.
errors.PATH_TOO_LONG: The path is too long to delete.
errors.NO_PREVIEW: Request and review a preview first.
errors.RISK_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED: Acknowledge the machine-wide risks before confirming.
errors.CONFIRM_TEXT_MISMATCH: The confirmation text must match exactly.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The package or activity could not be found.
errors.CONFLICT: A conflicting operation prevents this action. Refresh status and preview again.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The global package service is unavailable.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait before refreshing.
errors.HTTP_EXCEPTION: The backend could not complete the request.
errors.BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE: The backend is unavailable. Check status before another action.
errors.INVALID_RESPONSE: The response is invalid. Refresh status manually.

packageManagers.title: Project package manager version
packageManagers.scope: Changes only the packageManager declaration in this project's package.json. The npm/pnpm installed on this machine (global) does not change.
packageManagers.method: PkgSteward writes one field in package.json: no tool download, no install, no Corepack. Terminals follow the pin only if you use Corepack or pnpm's own version management.
packageManagers.registry: Versions come from the public npm registry (registry.npmjs.org).
packageManagers.toolUnsupported: {manager}: not supported by the app (declaration shown only)
packageManagers.leaf: This project is a workspace member; change the pin in the workspace root:
packageManagers.versionsHint: Only stable, non-deprecated versions with the installed tool's major are listed. Load versions first.
packageManagers.stopPreviewHint: Press Escape to stop the preview.
packageManagers.cleanupPending: The write task ended but its finishing steps (temporary file, operation log or data refresh) are pending; other dangerous actions stay locked. Select Retry finishing; the app does not write the file again.
packageManagers.lostNotice: The previous task can no longer be tracked. If it was a write, open package.json to check it before retrying.

status.lost: The task can no longer be tracked; press Refresh.
status.unknown: It is unknown whether the request reached the server; press Refresh and do not resend.

packageManagers.otherJob: Another project is changing its version; wait for that task to finish.

result.success: The packageManager declaration was written to package.json. The new pin is shown above.
result.cleanup: package.json was written but finishing steps are pending; press Refresh.
result.cancelledBefore: Cancelled before writing; package.json is unchanged.
result.failed: The pin was not changed; package.json is unchanged.
result.mayHaveChanged: package.json may have changed. Open the file to check it before retrying.

warnings.PIN_HASH_REMOVED: The old pin's hash is dropped; the app does not create a new hash.
warnings.PIN_DOES_NOT_SWITCH_RUNNER: The pin is a declaration only: PkgSteward keeps running commands with the installed tool.
warnings.DEV_ENGINES_NOT_MANAGED: package.json has devEngines; the app does not manage that field, so it does not change the pin.

limitations.EXTERNAL_EDIT_RACE: If another program edits package.json at the moment of writing, that edit may be overwritten.
limitations.PARENT_JUNCTION_RACE: If a parent folder is swapped for a junction at the moment of writing, the file may be written elsewhere.
limitations.CRASH_TEMP_RESIDUAL: If the app stops abruptly while writing, a temporary file may remain next to package.json.
